seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Open source starterkit for building your own cloud agent orchestrator, emphasizing ownership of intelligence in agent systems.
Recursively self-improving agents using frontier models like Fable 5 and DeepSeek Flash for complex tasks, enabling autonomous goal achievement like viral growth or profit maximization.
Primitive multiagent orchestration via dependent threads in coding agents, creating implicit kanban graphs for platform-product workflows.

global_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Formalizes memory as core state-management with write-manage-read loops, unifying temporal scope and policy-learned retention to turn stateless LLMs into adaptive agents; includes context compression, episodic history, and reflective updates.

Replaces passive RAG with hierarchical cognitive buffers and active curation for 18% efficiency gain and 58.6% memory reuse; solves context degradation via task/episodic buffers and consolidation layers.
Separate Memory Agent reviews trajectories, updates structured memory bank, and selectively injects reminders to prevent behavioral state decay; yields 8.3pp gains on benchmarks with Claude models.
